mapper.insert: insert into safety_water_flow_no (type, date, num) values (#{type}, now(), #{next})
update safety_water_flow_no set num = #{next} where type = #{type} and date = CURDATE()
mapper.select: select IFNULL(MAX(num), 0) from safety_water_flow_no where type = #{type} and date = CURDATE()
select IFNULL(MAX(num), 0) from safety_water_flow_no where type = #{type}
